timeline.summary: Siemens Energy Holding B.V. and Siemens Energy Holdco B.V. declared no encumbrance on Siemens Limited shares by 31-Mar-2026, holding none as of that date.
Siemens disclosed a ₹1,825 Cr internal work allocation from its group company, received March 25, 2026, for manufacturing and supply of bogies, traction motors and gearboxes.
Siemens Limited reported an 18-month transitional FY26 continuing revenue of ₹22,025.4 Cr, approved the amalgamation of its rail automation subsidiary, and recommended a dividend of ₹18 per share.
Siemens board approved the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary Siemens Rail Automation.
Siemens reported Q6FY26 revenue of ₹46.2 bn and new orders of ₹67.3 bn, with EBITDA impacted by commodity and currency headwinds.
Siemens Limited’s audio recording of its Analysts/Institutional Investors meet on May 28, 2026, is available on its website.
Siemens completed the sale of its Low Voltage and Geared Motors business to Innomotics India for ₹2,200 Cr on June 1, 2026.
Siemens reported Q1FY27 results with revenue growth of 14.8% YoY but PAT down 18.9% YoY due to margin pressure
Siemens Limited’s 68th AGM on August 11, 2026, unanimously approved ₹316.24 crore dividend for FY 2024-26.
Siemens Limited held its 68th AGM on August 11, 2026, approving director appointments and a dividend for the 18-month FY ended March 2026.
Siemens Limited's GST litigation over Halol property lease transfer concluded in its favour as Supreme Court dismissed the department's SLP on 20 August 2026
2026-09-07: Siemens Energy entities request reclassification from promoter to public category
2026-09-07: Siemens receives NCLT order dispensing with shareholder meetings for SRAPL amalgamation
Siemens Limited issued notices to shareholders and creditors on 12 September 2026 regarding the SRAPL amalgamation after NCLT dispensed with meeting requirements on 7 September 2026.
Siemens Limited Board approved reclassification of Siemens Energy entities from promoter to public category on 18 September 2026.
2026-09-24: Siemens receives NCLT approval for reduction of share capital in C&S Electric Limited
On 26 October 2026, C&S Electric became a wholly owned subsidiary of Siemens Limited after ROC registration of the NCLT-approved capital reduction.
